summary: The committed change preserves pending edits in non-submitted editor groups, retains the coupled origins and callback save contract, and has no actionable defect.

evidence: In public/admin_projects.js lines 278-283, dirty origins and redirects are preserved on audience saves, while dirty audiences are preserved on origin or redirect saves.
Lines 416-423 retain the save contract: audience saves submit audiences, while origin or redirect saves submit both origins and redirectUris.
Lines 288-302 skip rerendering each preserved group, so pending audience edits survive an origin save and pending origin or callback edits survive an audience save.
